content.title: Ryanair Issues Impressive Traffic Numbers for November 2025

content.title: Old Dominion Unveils Weak LTL Unit Performance for November
content.summary: ODFL's revenue per day fell 4.4% year over year in November 2025, owing to a 10% decrease in LTL tons per day, partially offset by an increase in LTL revenue per hundredweight.
